messages:
Nora (Eng Manager): Uh oh, encoder VM just hit a CPU stall and OBS froze for a sec. Holding the slide deck at slide 6. Can we do a 3-4 minute break and move Q&A to the end?
Carlos (AV Ops): Saw the spike, pushing the stream to backup-encoder-02 now. Starting incremental recording on the secondary capture box.
Priya (Host): Okay will pause the cadence, announce a short pause and tell folks we'll answer live Qs at the end. Also ask audience to drop short questions in this thread if they want priority.
Recorder Bot: HOTSWAP record -> s3://redwood-allhands/hot/3325607890/iso-enc-02-000.ts
Carlos (AV Ops): Command snippet I executed:
```
ssh avops@backup-encoder-02 \
  "systemctl start obs-fallback && ffmpeg -i rtmp://local/fallback -c copy \
  s3://redwood-allhands/backup/3325607890/backup-%03d.ts"
```
Infra Bot: Noting a transient disk io error on encoder-01 (~1m ago). Filing incident INC-33260.
Nora (Eng Manager): Thanks. Priya, can you ask presenters to re-announce Qs aloud when we resume? Also add a quick note on the recording about the backup segment.
Priya (Host): Yep. I'll put a slide note and say: "If your question is read, please repeat it before answer."
Zoe (Head of Product): Quick ask: can we timebox product roadmap questions to the first 15 minutes of Q&A? We have a few leadership responses prepared.
Nora (Eng Manager): Sounds good, Zoe. We'll queue roadmap items first when we resume live. Others can leave quick clarifying questions here.
Carlos (AV Ops): Backup stream looks healthy, switching player to backup in 30s. We'll keep ISO running until we confirm segment integrity.
Recorder Bot: Clip marker added at 00:00:00 and 00:12:30 -> s3://redwood-allhands/hot/3325607890/markers.json
Priya (Host): Rolling announcement: "Brief pause while we switch to backup encoder. We'll resume in ~3 minutes. Q&A moved to the end of the deck. If you have a question now, drop it here or save it for live Q&A."
Nora (Eng Manager): Post-meeting follow-ups: 1) Carlos to attach iso segments and checksums, 2) Infra to add incident root cause, 3) Recording team to stitch primary+backup segments and mark where fallback exists, 4) I'll publish final recording + TL;DR thread.
Zoe (Head of Product): Thanks everyone for the quick swap. Appreciate the heads-up for attendees.
Carlos (AV Ops): Uploading backup segs now, will link shortly.
Infra Bot: Incident INC-33260 created and assigned to infra-team.
Nora (Eng Manager): All good. Resuming on slide 6 in 45s. Host, please remind people to repeat questions out loud when asked.
Priya (Host): Will do. Resuming now."
